# Plotly runtime

`plotly.min.js` is Plotly.js **4.1.1**, copied unchanged from the installed
Plotly.py **7.1.0** package's `package_data/plotly.min.js`.

Original copyright and dependency notices are retained. See `LICENSE.plotly.txt`.
Plotly.js is MIT licensed: <https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js>.

The NYC Taxi page loads this local runtime only when analytical charts mount.
It uses the existing React framework and portfolio styling; there is no embedded
external dashboard or CDN requirement for the chart library.
